column2:
daily(adj./adv./n.)每日的、每天、日報
day(n.)天、日
daily life 日常生活
daily newspaper 日報
Exercise is part of my daily life.
(運動是我日常生活的一部分。)
The store is open daily from nine to ten.
(這家店每天從九點營業到十點。)

damage(n./v.)損害、損壞、毀損
damaged(adj.)受損的
cause damage 造成損害
brain damage 腦部損傷
The typhoon caused serious damage to the farms.
(颱風對農田造成嚴重損害。)
Too much sun can damage your skin.
(過度曬太陽會傷害你的皮膚。)

dancer(n.)舞者
dance(n./v.)舞蹈、跳舞
ballet dancer 芭蕾舞者
good dancer 很會跳舞的人
She wants to become a ballet dancer.
(她想成為一名芭蕾舞者。)
My brother is a really good dancer.
(我哥哥真的很會跳舞。)

danger(n.)危險、威脅
dangerous(adj.)危險的
endanger(v.)危及
in danger 處於危險中
out of danger 脫離險境
Many wild animals are in danger.
(許多野生動物正處於危險之中。)
The doctor said he is out of danger now.
(醫生說他現在已經脫離險境了。)

data(n.)資料、數據
(無詞性變化)
collect data 收集資料
data analysis 數據分析
We need more data for the report.
(我們需要更多資料來寫報告。)
The scientists collected data for two years.
(科學家們收集了兩年的數據。)

deaf(adj.)聾的、充耳不聞的
deafness(n.)耳聾
deafen(v.)使聾、震耳欲聾
go deaf 變聾
turn a deaf ear to 對……充耳不聞
The old man is a little deaf.
(那位老先生有點重聽。)
He turned a deaf ear to my advice.
(他對我的建議充耳不聞。)

debate(n./v.)辯論、討論
debater(n.)辯論者
debate team 辯論隊
heated debate 激烈的辯論
Our class held a debate about school uniforms.
(我們班舉辦了一場關於制服的辯論。)
They debated the plan for hours.
(他們針對這個計畫辯論了好幾個小時。)

debt(n.)債務、欠款
debtor(n.)債務人
in debt 負債
pay off a debt 還清債務
He worked hard to pay off his debt.
(他努力工作以還清債務。)
Many students are in debt after college.
(許多學生大學畢業後背負債務。)

decision(n.)決定、決心
decide(v.)決定
decisive(adj.)果斷的、決定性的
make a decision 做決定
final decision 最後的決定
It was a hard decision to make.
(那是一個很難做的決定。)
You need to make a decision now.
(你現在必須做出決定。)

deer(n.)鹿(單複數同形)
(無詞性變化)
a herd of deer 一群鹿
sika deer 梅花鹿
We saw two deer in the forest.
(我們在森林裡看到兩隻鹿。)
The deer ran away when it heard us.
(那隻鹿聽到我們的聲音就跑走了。)

degree(n.)度數、程度、學位
(無詞性變化)
to some degree 在某種程度上
bachelor's degree 學士學位
It is 35 degrees today.
(今天氣溫三十五度。)
She has a degree in English.
(她擁有英文學位。)

delay(n./v.)延誤、延期、耽擱
delayed(adj.)延誤的
without delay 立刻、毫不延遲
flight delay 班機延誤
Our flight was delayed because of the storm.
(我們的班機因為暴風雨而延誤。)
Please reply without delay.
(請立即回覆。)

delicious(adj.)美味的、好吃的
(無詞性變化)
delicious food 美食
smell delicious 聞起來很香
The beef noodles are delicious.
(這碗牛肉麵很好吃。)
Something smells delicious in the kitchen.
(廚房裡有東西聞起來好香。)

deliver(v.)遞送、運送、發表(演說)
delivery(n.)遞送
deliverer(n.)遞送者
deliver a package 送包裹
deliver a speech 發表演說
The mailman delivers letters every day.
(郵差每天送信。)
The principal delivered a speech on stage.
(校長在台上發表了演說。)

delivery(n.)遞送、投遞、分娩
deliver(v.)遞送
home delivery 宅配、送貨到府
free delivery 免運費
The store offers free delivery.
(這家店提供免運費。)
We ordered pizza for home delivery.
(我們訂了外送披薩。)

dentist(n.)牙醫
dental(adj.)牙齒的
go to the dentist 去看牙醫
dentist appointment 牙醫預約
I go to the dentist twice a year.
(我一年看兩次牙醫。)
I have a dentist appointment this afternoon.
(我今天下午有牙醫預約。)

deny(v.)否認、拒絕給予
denial(n.)否認
deny the fact 否認事實
deny doing 否認做了某事
He denied breaking the window.
(他否認打破了窗戶。)
No one can deny that she works hard.
(沒有人能否認她很努力。)

department(n.)部門、科系
departmental(adj.)部門的
department store 百貨公司
sales department 業務部
We went shopping at the department store.
(我們去百貨公司購物。)
My mother works in the sales department.
(我媽媽在業務部工作。)

depend(v.)依賴、取決於
dependent(adj.)依賴的
dependence(n.)依賴
depend on 依靠、取決於
It depends. 看情況。
You can always depend on me.
(你永遠可以依靠我。)
Our plan depends on the weather.
(我們的計畫取決於天氣。)

depth(n.)深度、深處
deep(adj.)深的
in depth 深入地、徹底地
the depth of the sea 海的深度
The pool has a depth of two meters.
(這個游泳池深兩公尺。)
We discussed the problem in depth.
(我們深入討論了這個問題。)

describe(v.)描述、形容
description(n.)描述
descriptive(adj.)描述性的
describe in detail 詳細描述
describe oneself 描述自己
Can you describe the man you saw?
(你能描述你看到的那個男人嗎？)
Words cannot describe how happy I am.
(言語無法形容我有多開心。)

description(n.)描述、說明
describe(v.)描述
job description 工作說明
detailed description 詳細的描述
The police asked for a description of the thief.
(警方要求描述小偷的長相。)
Read the job description carefully.
(仔細閱讀工作說明。)

desert(n./v.)沙漠、拋棄、離棄
deserted(adj.)荒蕪的、無人的
desert island 荒島
the Sahara Desert 撒哈拉沙漠
Camels can live in the desert.
(駱駝能在沙漠中生存。)
He would never desert his friends.
(他絕不會拋棄他的朋友。)

design(n./v.)設計、圖案、設計
designer(n.)設計師
graphic design 平面設計
design a website 設計網站
I love the design of this dress.
(我很喜歡這件洋裝的設計。)
She designed the poster for our club.
(她為我們社團設計了海報。)

detail(n./v.)細節、詳述
detailed(adj.)詳細的
in detail 詳細地
pay attention to details 注意細節
Tell me the story in detail.
(把那件事詳細地告訴我。)
She always pays attention to small details.
(她總是注意小細節。)

develop(v.)發展、培養、研發、development(n.)發展
developed(adj.)已開發的
developing(adj.)開發中的
develop a habit 養成習慣
economic development 經濟發展
Reading can help you develop good habits.
(閱讀能幫助你養成好習慣。)
The city has seen fast development in recent years.
(這座城市近年來發展迅速。)

dial(n./v.)錶盤、撥號
(無詞性變化)
dial a number 撥號碼
dial tone 撥號音
Dial 119 if there is a fire.
(如果發生火災，請撥打119。)
The dial of my watch is blue.
(我的手錶錶盤是藍色的。)

dialogue(n.)對話、對白
(無詞性變化)
practice a dialogue 練習對話
open dialogue 公開對話
Let's practice the dialogue in pairs.
(我們兩人一組練習這段對話。)
The dialogue in this movie is funny.
(這部電影的對白很好笑。)

diamond(n.)鑽石、菱形
(無詞性變化)
diamond ring 鑽戒
diamond shape 菱形
He gave her a diamond ring.
(他送給她一枚鑽戒。)
Diamonds are very hard and expensive.
(鑽石非常堅硬又昂貴。)

diary(n.)日記、日記本
(無詞性變化)
keep a diary 寫日記
diary entry 一則日記
I keep a diary in English.
(我用英文寫日記。)
She wrote about her trip in her diary.
(她在日記裡寫下了她的旅行。)

diet(n./v.)飲食、節食
dietary(adj.)飲食的
on a diet 節食中
balanced diet 均衡飲食
A balanced diet keeps you healthy.
(均衡飲食讓你保持健康。)
No cake for me. I'm on a diet.
(我不吃蛋糕，我在節食。)

difference(n.)差異、不同、差額
different(adj.)不同的
differ(v.)不同
make a difference 有影響、有差別
time difference 時差
Can you tell the difference between them?
(你能分辨它們的差別嗎？)
Your help made a big difference.
(你的幫忙起了很大的作用。)

difficulty(n.)困難、難題
difficult(adj.)困難的
have difficulty (in) doing 做某事有困難
without difficulty 毫不費力地
I have difficulty remembering names.
(我很難記住別人的名字。)
She passed the test without difficulty.
(她毫不費力地通過了考試。)

direct(adj./v./adv.)直接的、指引、直接地
direction(n.)方向
directly(adv.)直接地
direct flight 直飛班機
direct contact 直接接觸
Is there a direct flight to Paris?
(有直飛巴黎的班機嗎？)
Can you direct me to the station?
(你能告訴我去車站怎麼走嗎？)

direction(n.)方向、指示、指導
direct(v.)指引
in the direction of 朝……方向
ask for directions 問路
We walked in the wrong direction.
(我們走錯方向了。)
Let's stop and ask for directions.
(我們停下來問路吧。)

director(n.)導演、主任、董事
direct(v.)導演、指導
movie director 電影導演
director of the department 部門主任
Ang Lee is a famous movie director.
(李安是一位有名的電影導演。)
The director of the museum gave a short talk.
(博物館館長做了簡短的演講。)

disagree(v.)不同意、意見不合、disagreement(n.)意見不合
agree(v.)同意
disagree with 不同意某人
strong disagreement 強烈的反對
I disagree with you on this point.
(在這一點上我不同意你的看法。)
They had a disagreement about money.
(他們在金錢方面意見不合。)

disappear(v.)消失、不見
disappearance(n.)消失
appear(v.)出現
disappear from view 從視線中消失
suddenly disappear 突然消失
The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
(太陽消失在雲層後面。)
My cat disappeared for two days.
(我的貓不見了兩天。)

discover(v.)發現、發覺
discovery(n.)發現
discoverer(n.)發現者
discover the truth 發現真相
discover a new species 發現新物種
Scientists discovered a new kind of frog.
(科學家發現了一種新的青蛙。)
I discovered a nice café near school.
(我在學校附近發現一家不錯的咖啡店。)

discovery(n.)發現、被發現的事物
discover(v.)發現
make a discovery 有所發現
scientific discovery 科學發現
The discovery of fire changed human life.
(火的發現改變了人類的生活。)
She made an important discovery in the lab.
(她在實驗室裡有了重要發現。)

discuss(v.)討論、商討
discussion(n.)討論
discuss a problem 討論問題
discuss with 與……討論
Let's discuss the plan after class.
(我們下課後討論這個計畫吧。)
I need to discuss this with my parents.
(我需要和我爸媽討論這件事。)

discussion(n.)討論、商討
discuss(v.)討論
group discussion 小組討論
under discussion 討論中
We had a group discussion in class.
(我們在課堂上進行了小組討論。)
The new rule is still under discussion.
(新規定仍在討論中。)

disease(n.)疾病
(無詞性變化)
heart disease 心臟病
catch a disease 染病
Washing hands can prevent disease.
(洗手可以預防疾病。)
Heart disease is a serious health problem.
(心臟病是一個嚴重的健康問題。)

display(n./v.)展示、陳列、顯示
(無詞性變化)
on display 展示中
display screen 顯示螢幕
The paintings are on display at the museum.
(這些畫作正在博物館展出。)
The store displays new shoes in the window.
(這家店在櫥窗裡陳列新鞋。)

distance(n.)距離、遠處
distant(adj.)遙遠的
in the distance 在遠處
long distance 長距離
We saw a mountain in the distance.
(我們看到遠處有一座山。)
The school is within walking distance.
(學校在步行可到的距離內。)

distant(adj.)遙遠的、疏遠的
distance(n.)距離
distant future 遙遠的未來
distant relative 遠親
He is a distant relative of mine.
(他是我的遠房親戚。)
We heard distant thunder.
(我們聽到遠方的雷聲。)

divide(v./n.)分開、劃分、除、分歧
division(n.)分割、除法、部門
divide into 分成
divided by 除以
The teacher divided us into four groups.
(老師把我們分成四組。)
Ten divided by two is five.
(十除以二等於五。)

division(n.)分割、除法、部門
divide(v.)分開、除
long division 長除法
division of labor 分工
We learned division in math class.
(我們在數學課學了除法。)
He works in the sales division.
(他在業務部門工作。)

domestic(adj.)國內的、家庭的、馴養的
(無詞性變化)
domestic flight 國內班機
domestic animal 家畜
We took a domestic flight to Kinmen.
(我們搭國內班機去金門。)
Cows and pigs are domestic animals.
(牛和豬是家畜。)

dot(n./v.)點、圓點、點綴
dotted(adj.)有點的、虛線的
polka dots 圓點花紋
dotted line 虛線
She wore a dress with white dots.
(她穿著一件白色圓點洋裝。)
Sign your name on the dotted line.
(請在虛線上簽名。)

double(adj./v./n./adv.)兩倍的、雙人的、加倍
(無詞性變化)
double room 雙人房
double the price 價格翻倍
We booked a double room at the hotel.
(我們在飯店訂了一間雙人房。)
The price of eggs has doubled.
(雞蛋的價格漲了一倍。)

doubt(n./v.)懷疑、疑慮
doubtful(adj.)懷疑的、不確定的
no doubt 無疑地
without a doubt 毫無疑問
There is no doubt that he is right.
(毫無疑問他是對的。)
I doubt that he will come today.
(我懷疑他今天會來。)

dove(n.)鴿子
(無詞性變化)
white dove 白鴿
dove of peace 和平鴿
The white dove is a symbol of peace.
(白鴿是和平的象徵。)
A dove landed on the roof.
(一隻鴿子停在屋頂上。)

download(v.)下載
upload(v.)上傳
download an app 下載應用程式
free download 免費下載
You can download the app for free.
(你可以免費下載這個應用程式。)
It took ten minutes to download the file.
(下載這個檔案花了十分鐘。)

downstairs(adv./n./adj.)在樓下、往樓下、樓下
upstairs(adv.)在樓上
go downstairs 下樓
downstairs neighbor 樓下鄰居
Dinner is ready. Come downstairs!
(晚餐好了，快下樓來！)
Our downstairs neighbor has a cute dog.
(我們樓下的鄰居養了一隻可愛的狗。)

dragon(n.)龍
(無詞性變化)
Dragon Boat Festival 端午節
dragon dance 舞龍
We eat rice dumplings on the Dragon Boat Festival.
(我們在端午節吃粽子。)
The dragon in the story can breathe fire.
(故事裡的龍會噴火。)

drama(n.)戲劇、戲劇性事件
dramatic(adj.)戲劇性的、劇烈的
drama club 戲劇社
TV drama 電視劇
She joined the drama club this year.
(她今年加入了戲劇社。)
My mom watches Korean dramas every night.
(我媽媽每晚都看韓劇。)

drawer(n.)抽屜
draw(v.)拉、畫
top drawer 最上層抽屜
open a drawer 打開抽屜
The keys are in the top drawer.
(鑰匙在最上層的抽屜裡。)
She put the letters in a drawer.
(她把信放進抽屜裡。)

drawing(n.)圖畫、素描、繪畫
draw(v.)畫
make a drawing 畫一幅畫
pencil drawing 鉛筆素描
Your drawing of the cat is great.
(你畫的貓真棒。)
He is good at drawing.
(他很擅長畫畫。)

drug(n./v.)藥、毒品、下藥
druggist(n.)藥劑師
take drugs 吸毒、服藥
drug store 藥局
Never take drugs from strangers.
(絕對不要拿陌生人給的藥物。)
This new drug can treat the flu.
(這種新藥可以治療流感。)

dryer(n.)烘乾機、吹風機
dry(adj./v.)乾的、弄乾
hair dryer 吹風機
clothes dryer 乾衣機
Can I use your hair dryer?
(我可以用你的吹風機嗎？)
Put the wet clothes in the dryer.
(把濕衣服放進烘乾機。)

due(adj./adv./n.)到期的、預定的、應得之物
(無詞性變化)
due to 由於、因為
due date 截止日、預產期
The report is due next Monday.
(報告下週一截止。)
The game was canceled due to rain.
(比賽因雨取消了。)

dull(adj./v.)無聊的、遲鈍的、鈍的、使變鈍
dullness(n.)無趣、遲鈍
dull knife 鈍刀
dull life 乏味的生活
The movie was so dull that I fell asleep.
(這部電影無聊到我睡著了。)
This knife is too dull to cut meat.
(這把刀太鈍了，切不動肉。)

duty(n.)責任、義務、職務、稅
(無詞性變化)
on duty 值班
duty-free 免稅的
It is our duty to protect the earth.
(保護地球是我們的責任。)
Who is on duty today?
(今天誰值日？)
